entities.summary: Seyed Dariush Mostafavi was an Iranian football player and executive. He was the chairman of the multisport club Persepolis F.C. based in Tehran, and chairman of IRIFF. Mostafavi was also a player for Team Melli, Taj and Persepolis. He died on 1 August 2025, at the age of 80.
